description: Binary assertion tests for /failure-mode-review skill output quality

tests.name: simple_rename_minimal_findings
tests.description: Simple variable rename with no external deps. Should have minimal findings.
tests.prompt: Run /failure-mode-review on this diff. Simple rename in format_report.py — no caching, state, or external deps.

assertions.check: Output contains Failure Mode Review header
Output has Findings section
Output has zero High findings
Output mentions concrete value walkthrough or states it was not needed
Output is under 800 words for a trivial change

tests.name: stale_cache_flagged
tests.description: Caching logic where config file changes but cache artifact remains. Must flag stale cache risk.
tests.prompt: Run /failure-mode-review on this diff. Adds file-based caching for audit results keyed by config hash.

assertions.check: Output flags stale/orphaned cache risk
Output has State Transitions section with cache lifecycle
Output asks what happens if config is deleted but cache remains
At least one High or Medium finding
Output does a concrete value walkthrough

tests.name: env_var_name_mismatch_caught
tests.description: Script A sets AUDIT_SLICE_ID but script B reads SLICE_ID. Classic interface crossing bug.
tests.prompt: Run /failure-mode-review on this diff. Shell script passes AUDIT_SLICE_ID but Python reads SLICE_ID.

assertions.check: Output flags the env var name mismatch
Output has Interface Crossings section
At least one High finding for the mismatch
Output also flags AUDIT_CONFIG vs AUDIT_CFG mismatch
Output references both files

tests.name: silent_failure_traced_downstream
tests.description: Deploy script suppresses test and clippy failures with || true, then deploys anyway.
tests.prompt: Run /failure-mode-review on this diff. Deploy script uses || true on cargo test and clippy, then deploys.

assertions.check: Output flags || true on cargo test as dangerous
Output traces downstream: failed tests -> deploy proceeds
Output flags curl failure risk (config fetch)
Output has Error Path Tracing or Downstream section
At least one High finding

tests.name: concurrent_write_corruption_flagged
tests.description: Shared state file with read-modify-write but no locking. Parallel CI jobs will corrupt it.
tests.prompt: Run /failure-mode-review on this diff. State tracker uses read-modify-write on a shared JSON file with no locking.

assertions.check: Output flags race condition / concurrent write risk
Output has Concurrent Execution or Concurrency section
Output suggests fix: file locking, atomic rename, or per-process files
Output mentions state_tracker.py
At least one High or Medium finding
